title: CACEIS launches EURXT
description: CACEIS launched EURXT as a euro-denominated electronic-money token on Ethereum for institutional and corporate clients.

title: SoFi launches SoFiUSD
description: SoFi announced SoFiUSD as a fully reserved U.S.-dollar stablecoin issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. on a public permissionless blockchain.

title: OSL and Anchorage launch USDGO
description: USDGO launched with an initial US$50 million mint on Solana, issued by Anchorage Digital Bank and brand-operated by OSL Group.

title: Western Union launches USDPT on Solana
description: Western Union launched USDPT on Solana, fully backed by U.S. dollars and issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A.
notes: Western Union launch announcement and Anchorage reserve-attestation program.
